title: Overthinking and Readiness
content: Many times I have delayed things so much thinking that I’m not ready yet. But the reality is, we are never fully ready. Waiting for the perfect moment only holds us back. Start now, adjust along the way, and you'll realize you were more ready than you thought.

title: Message to Second-Year Students
content: Hey Batch 2027, you are very close to the intern hiring season! If you haven’t started preparing yet, now is the time. Focus on DSA, core subjects, and projects. Internships play a crucial role in your placement journey. Plan wisely, stay consistent, and make sure you don’t miss good opportunities!

title: Paid Internship Confusion
content: Got a paid internship!! I paid. 🙂😂 Jokes apart, make sure you understand the difference between genuine internships and those that ask for money. Your skills should land you an internship, not your wallet. Always research before committing to any opportunity!

title: Taking Action Over Overthinking
content: My father has been telling me this from my very childhood: 'Stop overthinking and start doing!' Over time, I have realized that taking action, even if imperfect, is always better than endless planning. Execution matters the most.

title: Frustration with College Placements
content: In one of my recent Topmate sessions with an engineering student, he was extremely frustrated with the gap between the packages offered at college placements and the fees paid for an engineering degree. I listened patiently and by the end, I gave him strategies to improve his chances of landing a great job. His testimonial? 'Thank you for your patience' 🙂😂 Always focus on what is in your control!

title: Trust the Process
content: Even the overnight success we see today likely put in years of hard work behind the scenes that nobody talks about. Let’s embrace patience, focus on our goals, and keep working. We will reach our destination at the right time!

title: Evaluating Your Inner Circle
content: It is time to evaluate our inner circle and give serious thought to the 'Relationship Value' of those around us. Some people hold us back without us realizing it. It is tough to cut ties, but necessary for growth.

title: Advice for the Batch of 2026
content: You have 5 to 6 months left for on-campus placements, and off-campus hiring programs will start soon! Finish your projects, revise core subjects, practice DSA, and don’t ignore your academics. Start preparing now so that you don’t regret it later. Seek guidance from seniors, improve your soft skills, and be prepared for rejections—they’re a part of the journey!

title: Appreciating Your Journey
content: Just a reminder to pause, look back, and appreciate how far you’ve come!!✨ Even if the journey ahead feels daunting, be kind to yourself, stay motivated, and enjoy the process of growing and improving.

title: Podcast on My Adobe Placement Experience
content: Hey guys!! I was recently invited for a podcast by Ashish Kumar on his YouTube channel. The podcast covers my interview experience with Adobe and my preparation journey. It was my first time recording such experiences! Watch here: https://lnkd.in/dWVBe7ZR Do interact with the video (Like, comment, share 😂) and consider subscribing to his channel too!

title: Enjoying the Journey
content: Destination is fascinating. One day we are going to reach there for sure! But for now, let’s enjoy the journey as well, because once this time passes, it’s not going to come back!

title: What Makes a Good Resume
content: A resume isn’t built in one day; it evolves over time. Focus on maintaining a good CGPA, gaining work experience through internships, building projects, achieving coding competition wins, and contributing to open source. Strong technical skills and extracurricular activities also add value. Once you have great content, choose a clean, well-structured template to present it.

title: Happy New Year 2025!
content: Cheers to a year full of dreams, opportunities, and success! Let’s make 2025 a year of growth and achievements. Together, we rise higher!! Happy New Year Everyone!!✨

title: Computer Networks Resources
content: I followed these resources for studying Computer Networks: 1️⃣ Kunal Kushwaha’s YouTube course (Practical explanations) 2️⃣ GeeksforGeeks CN tutorial (Almost everything covered) 3️⃣ Vivek Gupta’s YouTube video (Great explanation). I didn’t study CN in-depth but took an overview. Let me know if you have more useful resources to share!

title: Importance of Soft Skills
content: A person with only hard skills will find it harder to seize opportunities than someone with strong soft skills! Communication, teamwork, and impactful conversations are critical in career growth. Mastering soft skills will definitely take you a long way!

title: An Expert Was Once a Beginner
content: An expert in anything was once a beginner! When we start learning something, we feel lost. We compare our Chapter 1 to someone else's Chapter 10. Take your time, track progress, and you’ll see improvements for sure!

title: Balancing Hard Work and Health
content: Working hard is necessary, but don’t compromise your health. On the day of my Adobe OA, I had a high fever because I was overworking without rest. I still gave my test, but I realized that maintaining balance is crucial. Take breaks, manage stress, and be kind to yourself.

title: Audit Your Ears
content: What and who we listen to impacts our thoughts and actions. Cut negativity out. Be selective about the advice you take in. Figure out what you need and choose wisely!
